name: Hajin, Divine Beast of Calamity
text: This card cannot be Normal summoned/set, must be special summoned by banishing 5 level 12 monsters from your field. While this card is on the field your opponent cannot conduct there Battle Phase. If this card is sent to the GY banish every other card in the GY then Special Summon this cars. This cards Special Summon cannot be nageted.
